phase5_fusion_calibration.diagnosis: grand_bridge's proof body never consumes P.loss_ledger_closed in the current G26Verify scope. The small-N branch invokes P.finite_verified (Pillar 3, a structural hypothesis not itself an axiom). The large-N branch is `sorry` by construction (GRH dependency, preserved per watchlist closure discipline). Structural G26 axioms (U1_to_U6_bound and the five Riemann Bridge / U7 Seal axioms) become consumed witnesses only at the call site where a concrete ProofPillars is instantiated and a LossLedger.isClosed proof is supplied. No such call site exists in G26Verify, so the axioms remain inert in verified-theorem dependency closures. Type-structural improvement (machine-enforceable contract) confirmed; axiomatic exposition deferred to actual caller emergence.
phase5_fusion_calibration.methodological_lesson: Predictions about transitive axiom exposure require checking that callers actually consume the relevant pillar — type signatures alone don't propagate axioms. Adding to the calibration log for future programmes.
